findings.evidence: Firecrawl returned SCRAPE_DNS_RESOLUTION_ERROR for https://sp.properties/about. Windows Resolve-DnsName sp.properties -Type A independently returned DNS_ERROR_RCODE_NAME_ERROR. content/site.ts defaults to https://sp.properties.
findings.impact: The configured canonical destination is unavailable in these checks. Search discovery cannot be validated until a working permanent website address is known.
findings.nextAction: Confirm the owned permanent domain, configure NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and the matching www redirect, connect DNS/hosting, and deploy.
findings.verify: Verify public HTTPS 200 responses, rendered canonical/robots/sitemap URLs, then use Google Search Console URL Inspection. Do not replace canonicals with a temporary devtunnel.

findings.evidence: Professional company page replaces house-type cards and concept images. One H1, local company copy, four linked services, full office contact details, page metadata and AboutPage JSON-LD are present.
findings.impact: Provides clear business and location context to people and search engines.
findings.verify: Lint, TypeScript, production build and browser checks passed. AboutPage references the shared business entity; service anchors and internal destinations work.

findings.evidence: Exact coordinates were explicitly marked unconfirmed in content/site.ts but were being emitted in businessSchema().
findings.action: Stopped publishing unconfirmed coordinates. Existing visible address and phone remain unchanged.
findings.verify: Browser JSON-LD inspection confirms no geo field and confirms the phone matches visible office details.

findings.nextAction: Confirm the Business Profile Maps link and ownership. Verify real primary category, company name, address, phone and opening hours against current business details; add genuine office/project photos and respond to genuine reviews.
findings.verify: Check the public profile and all owned contact profiles for consistent current details. Do not invent reviews, credentials, opening hours or coordinates.

findings.nextAction: Verify domain ownership, submit the sitemap, inspect /about and relevant service/location pages, and track actual impressions, clicks and local query performance.
findings.verify: Use actual Search Console reports; no top-three ranking or timeline is guaranteed.
